title: Does 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' Cast Know Their Film Locations?

lines.en: What is your favorite thing about working with Meryl? Give me a minute. No.
lines.zh: 你最喜歡跟 Meryl 合作的哪一點？給我一分鐘。不行。

lines.en: So, can I pass on some of these questions? How does it work? I'm Emily Blunt. I'm Meryl Streep. I'm Anne Hathaway. I'm Stanley Tucci.
lines.zh: 所以這些問題我可以跳過嗎？規則是怎樣？我是 Emily Blunt。我是 Meryl Streep。我是 Anne Hathaway。我是 Stanley Tucci。

lines.en: And we have all filmed in some pretty amazing places.
lines.zh: 我們都在一些很棒的地方拍過戲。

lines.en: So, let's see who remembers them best.
lines.zh: 來看看誰記得最清楚吧。

lines.en: Oh, I know what that is. I think it's It's San Francisco. Say it. Princess Diaries. It is.
lines.zh: 喔，我知道那是哪裡。我覺得是……是舊金山。說出來。《麻雀變公主》。沒錯。

lines.en: We are definitely in San Francisco.
lines.zh: 我們絕對是在舊金山。

lines.en: I know what's the fastest way back to the consulate, but I hate this hill.
lines.zh: 我知道回領事館最快的路，但我討厭這座坡。

lines.en: I do believe I'm beginning to feel that corn dog.
lines.zh: 我確實開始感覺到那根熱狗的威力了。

lines.en: One of my first things that I ever did on film where I was at the top of the hill and they handed me a scooter.
lines.zh: 那是我第一次在電影裡做的事之一，我站在坡頂，他們遞給我一台滑板車。

lines.en: And they said, "Okay, you're just going to go down the hill. We've done it. It's totally safe." Did you do it? And I said, "Okay."
lines.zh: 他們說：「好，你就從坡上滑下去。我們試過了，完全安全。」你滑了嗎？我說：「好。」

lines.en: And then And they said, "And if you get nervous, just you know, just use the brake. It'll be fine."
lines.zh: 然後他們說：「如果你緊張，就，你知道，就踩煞車。不會有事的。」

lines.en: I picked up so much momentum so fast. Heart pounding. Oh my gosh.
lines.zh: 我一下子就衝得好快。心臟狂跳。天啊。

lines.en: And I So, I just hit the brake immediately and rode the brake the entire time down.
lines.zh: 所以我馬上踩煞車，一路踩著煞車滑到底。

lines.en: And I just remember I got to the bottom and they were like, "Okay, we think we got it."
lines.zh: 我只記得我到了坡底，他們說：「好，我們覺得拍到了。」

lines.en: And I was like, "That's good."
lines.zh: 我就說：「那很好。」

lines.en: You're like, "Cuz I won't be doing that again."
lines.zh: 你是說：「因為我不會再滑第二次了。」

lines.en: And they're like, "Do you want to go get a If you got it, I don't want to waste the time." Me? A a princess? Shut up.
lines.zh: 他們說：「你要不要去拿……如果拍到了，我不想浪費時間。」我？一個公主？少來了。

lines.en: And what was it like showing Julie Andrews around San Francisco?
lines.zh: 帶 Julie Andrews 逛舊金山是什麼感覺？

lines.en: I didn't personally show Julie around San Francisco, but filming with her I mean, just an absolute high-water experience.
lines.zh: 我沒有親自帶 Julie 逛舊金山，但和她一起拍戲，我是說，那絕對是人生巔峰級的經驗。

lines.en: She's the most magical hug of a human being. And she's so generous. She's so warm.
lines.zh: 她的擁抱是全世界最神奇的。她非常大方。非常溫暖。

lines.en: She's so friendly and she's just this real light.
lines.zh: 她非常友善，就是一道真正的光。

lines.en: She has the most amazing energy. Just really, really gracious.
lines.zh: 她有最棒的能量。真的真的非常親切。

lines.en: And we had a great time and we ate corn dogs together again and again, and again. Well, here it goes.
lines.zh: 我們玩得很開心，一起吃了一次又一次的熱狗。好，下一個。

lines.en: Oh, I know what that is.
lines.zh: 喔，我知道那是哪裡。

lines.en: I know what it is.
lines.zh: 我知道那是什麼。

lines.en: Oh, I know what that is.
lines.zh: 喔，我知道那是哪裡。

lines.en: We'll let you guys say it.
lines.zh: 讓你們來說吧。

lines.en: It's boring if I say I know what that is.
lines.zh: 如果我說我知道那是什麼就太無聊了。

lines.en: Go on, Stanley, what is this? Stanley is Spanish. No. I've no idea. I think it's Oppenheimer. Oh. Yes.
lines.zh: 說吧，Stanley，這是什麼？Stanley 是……不是。我完全不知道。我覺得是《奧本海默》。喔。對。

lines.en: So, this was the Georgia O'Keeffe property, I think, in the middle of nowhere, the New Mexican desert.
lines.zh: 這是 Georgia O'Keeffe 的莊園，我想，在新墨西哥沙漠的荒郊野外。

lines.en: I was ill-prepared for winter in the New Mexican desert.
lines.zh: 我完全沒準備好面對新墨西哥沙漠的冬天。

lines.en: All I remember is just being it being just Baltic.
lines.zh: 我只記得冷到不行。

lines.en: And I remember Chris Nolan refusing to wear one of those big puffy jackets, cuz he wanted to be in it with us.
lines.zh: 我記得 Chris Nolan 堅持不穿那種大羽絨外套，因為他想跟我們一起挨冷。

lines.en: But whenever I would come on set in my big puffy jacket, he'd go, "Can you take your actors actor's security blanket off?" Going to New Mexico.
lines.zh: 但每次我穿著大羽絨外套走進片場，他就會說：「你可以把你那件演員的安全毯脫掉嗎？」要去新墨西哥。

lines.en: To my ranch with friends. You should come. It was astonishingly beautiful.
lines.zh: 「去我的牧場，和朋友們一起。你應該來。」那裡美得驚人。

lines.en: Like, I think the New Mexican skies are just this vast, this mythic story space to make that movie. It was wild. Jesus. I mean, um oh.
lines.zh: 我覺得新墨西哥的天空就是這麼遼闊，是拍那部電影最神話般的故事空間。太狂了。天啊。我是說，嗯，喔。

lines.en: Yes, okay. That's a little island of of Skopelos. Oh, it's Mamma Mia.
lines.zh: 對，好。那是 Skopelos 小島。喔，是《媽媽咪呀！》。

lines.en: Those steps, I ran up those steps, and I thought, "I could do that once."
lines.zh: 那些階梯，我跑上那些階梯，我想：「我可以跑一次。」

lines.en: And they did it more than once. Yeah. It's an amazing spot. It's almost improbable.
lines.zh: 結果他們拍了不只一次。對。那是個很棒的地方。幾乎令人難以置信。

lines.en: There is a little chapel on there, on the top, but it's not the one we shot in.
lines.zh: 上面頂端有一座小教堂，但不是我們拍戲的那座。

lines.en: We shot in indoors, in England.
lines.zh: 我們是在英國的室內拍的。

lines.en: Did you live on the island together?
lines.zh: 你們有一起住在島上嗎？

lines.en: Or like, how much was it in England, and how much was on the island?
lines.zh: 或者，有多少是在英國拍、多少在島上拍？

lines.en: We shot the entire movie in Pinewood Studios for, you know, maybe 3 months.
lines.zh: 我們整部片都在松林製片廠拍，你知道，大概拍了三個月。

lines.en: And then the last 3 weeks, we went and shot all the outdoor parts. a fun time. That was really magic.
lines.zh: 然後最後三週，我們去拍所有的戶外場景。很好玩的時光。那真的很神奇。

lines.en: We had so much fun, So many laughs.
lines.zh: 我們玩得超開心，笑了好多次。

lines.en: This just looks so joyful. I feel it.
lines.zh: 這看起來好歡樂。我感受得到。

lines.en: That place is is remarkable.
lines.zh: 那個地方真的很不凡。

lines.en: And it was so fragrant.
lines.zh: 而且那裡好香。

lines.en: Wild rosemary and fruits and it was just so beautiful and fragrant. That was the thing.
lines.zh: 野生迷迭香和水果，就是好美、好香。那就是那裡最特別的地方。

lines.en: You woke up in the morning and you smelled all the herbs and things growing. Dawn.
lines.zh: 早上醒來就聞到所有香草和植物的味道。黎明。

lines.en: I know that they say Aw. Oh, yeah. That was fun. That was fun. Yeah.
lines.zh: 我知道他們說……噢。喔，對。那很好玩。那很好玩。對。

lines.en: That's Julie & Julia, we shot in Paris. Aw.
lines.zh: 那是《美味關係》，我們在巴黎拍的。噢。

lines.en: We shot most of it in I think we shot in um
lines.zh: 大部分我們是在……我想我們是在，嗯……

lines.en: I don't know because you gave me a martini every night.
lines.zh: 我不知道，因為你每天晚上都給我一杯馬丁尼。

lines.en: I never knew where we were.
lines.zh: 我從來不知道我們在哪裡。

lines.en: I think we shot Silvercup, I think, didn't we? This is Queens. Beautiful. Beautiful. Beautiful.
lines.zh: 我想我們是在 Silvercup 攝影棚拍的，對吧？這是皇后區。好美。好美。好美。

lines.en: I thought we were going to go to Paris for the entire film. No. Queens.
lines.zh: 我本來以為整部片都要去巴黎拍。結果沒有，是皇后區。

lines.en: But then we ended up in Paris for about 10 days. Oh, gorgeous.
lines.zh: 但最後我們在巴黎待了大概十天。喔，好美。

lines.en: Had a great great great time.
lines.zh: 玩得非常非常開心。

lines.en: I feel that I am French. I just must be.
lines.zh: 我覺得我是法國人。我一定是。

lines.en: And the great thing is wherever we were shooting, we'd go we'd have a lunch break, we would just go find a restaurant.
lines.zh: 最棒的是，不管我們在哪裡拍，午休時間我們就會去找一家餐廳。

lines.en: What is your favorite thing about working with Meryl?
lines.zh: 你最喜歡跟 Meryl 合作的哪一點？

lines.en: You give me a minute. No.
lines.zh: 給我一分鐘。不行。

lines.en: So, can I pass on this Mhm. How does it work?
lines.zh: 那這題我可以跳過嗎？嗯。規則是怎樣？

lines.en: I was always an enormous fan, although we are not terribly apart you know, huge age difference.
lines.zh: 我一直都是她的超級粉絲，雖然我們年紀沒有差很多，你知道，巨大的年齡差距。

lines.en: And then when I got to know her, I became an even greater fan.
lines.zh: 然後當我認識她之後，我變成更大的粉絲。

lines.en: But I was I'm I'm still quite nervous, though we've worked together a few times. I'm still nervous. So, we're yeah. am.
lines.zh: 但我到現在還是很緊張，雖然我們合作過好幾次了。我還是很緊張。所以我們……對。

lines.en: I still get a little little bit and I go what am I doing here? You know? Are you 60 yet? I'm 65. Oh my god.
lines.zh: 我還是會有一點點緊張，會想：我在這裡做什麼？你知道嗎？你 60 歲了嗎？我 65 了。天啊。

lines.en: Okay, well, I'm way older than you, so.
lines.zh: 好吧，那我比你老多了。

lines.en: I was trying to do you a favor. Okay. Um, but I got it. I got it. I got it. I got it. I got it.
lines.zh: 我是想幫你一個忙。好。嗯，但我懂了，我懂了，我懂了。我懂了。我懂了。

lines.en: BUT I am I still She's so playful. She's so funny. She's so smart.
lines.zh: 但我還是……她好調皮。她好好笑。她好聰明。

lines.en: She understands the scene better than anyone.
lines.zh: 她比任何人都更懂那場戲。

lines.en: I have to remember to act with her and not just watch her.
lines.zh: 我得記得要跟她對戲，而不是只看著她演。

lines.en: That's the great part and the scary part.
lines.zh: 那是最棒的部分，也是最可怕的部分。

lines.en: Sometimes I just sort of want to watch and I'm like, oh god, I think I have to say something now.
lines.zh: 有時候我只想看著她，然後我就想：天啊，我想我現在該說台詞了。

lines.en: I do know what this is.
lines.zh: 這個我知道是什麼。

lines.en: This is my husband's movie.
lines.zh: 這是我老公的電影。

lines.en: This is A Quiet Place Part Two. I remember this scene.
lines.zh: 這是《噤界 II》。我記得這場戲。

lines.en: I remember being slightly afraid of ticks. Where was it? Buffalo? Oh, yeah.
lines.zh: 我記得我有點怕壁蝨。那是在哪裡？水牛城？喔，對。

lines.en: Our amazing grounds guy had created all of this. It was actually nothing. It was dirt.
lines.zh: 我們超厲害的場地人員打造了這一切。那裡其實什麼都沒有，只有泥土。

lines.en: I remember Pedro coming in and creating this whole jungle. It was so cool. I remember this scene. I have the baby. Just had the baby.
lines.zh: 我記得 Pedro 進來打造了整片叢林。太酷了。我記得這場戲。我抱著寶寶。剛生完寶寶。

lines.en: That's smart to have a child in a silent world. Mhm.
lines.zh: 在一個安靜無聲的世界裡生小孩，真聰明。嗯。

lines.en: And I come through the gate.
lines.zh: 然後我穿過大門。

lines.en: And I set off a alarm. Run.
lines.zh: 結果觸發了警報。快跑。

lines.en: So, we can tell that my husband is very sick man cuz he wrote all of these scenes.
lines.zh: 所以我們可以看出我老公是個很變態的人，因為這些戲都是他寫的。

lines.en: I remember it being 100° that day.
lines.zh: 我記得那天氣溫有 100 度（攝氏 38 度）。

lines.en: And I remember John saying to me, "Can you do like a fake stumble as you're running?"
lines.zh: 我記得 John 跟我說：「你跑的時候可以假裝絆一下嗎？」

lines.en: And I used to have one good knee and now I have two knees because of this fake stumble.
lines.zh: 我本來有一個好膝蓋，現在因為這個假絆倒，兩個膝蓋都……

lines.en: But I really remember that day cuz of the astonishing Noah Jupe who played our son in it.
lines.zh: 但我真的記得那一天，是因為演我們兒子的 Noah Jupe 表現得太驚人了。

lines.en: And he gets trapped in a bear trap.
lines.zh: 他被捕熊夾夾住了。

lines.en: It was an amazing shot.
lines.zh: 那是一個很驚人的鏡頭。

lines.en: John came up with it.
lines.zh: 是 John 想出來的。

lines.en: The shot like came down like that as we were running, running, running.
lines.zh: 那個鏡頭就像這樣往下拍，我們一直跑、跑、跑。

lines.en: Right as he's about step in the bear trap, it hits the bear trap and people in the audience went and he steps in it and it clamps on him and this child had to give out a scream and it literally chills my blood thinking about it.
lines.zh: 就在他快踩到捕熊夾時，鏡頭拍到捕熊夾，觀眾都嚇一跳，然後他踩上去，夾子夾住他，這個孩子得放聲尖叫，光是想到都讓我血液發涼。

lines.en: He was just astonishing that day.
lines.zh: 他那天的表現太驚人了。

lines.en: Oh, we all know this one. one. this one.
lines.zh: 喔，這個我們都知道。這個。

lines.en: We're all in it in some spiritual way.
lines.zh: 我們某種精神上都有參與其中。

lines.en: Uh this is Devil Wears Prada. This is Paris.
lines.zh: 呃，這是《穿著 Prada 的惡魔》。這是巴黎。

lines.en: Filming in Paris is great. It is amazing.
lines.zh: 在巴黎拍戲很棒。太棒了。

lines.en: I wouldn't know on that show.
lines.zh: 那部片我不會知道。

lines.en: Wait, you didn't go to Paris? didn't go. No, I didn't go.
lines.zh: 等等，你沒去巴黎？沒去。沒有，我沒去。

lines.en: What about the scene where you have the money. For your entourage. No. My entourage, Roy?
lines.zh: 那你拿錢的那場戲呢？給你的隨行人員。沒有。我的隨行人員？ROY？

lines.en: So what about when you were coming up the steps? What's that's uh somewhere In New York. In New York, yeah.
lines.zh: 那你走上階梯的那場呢？那是……某個地方，在紐約。在紐約，對。

lines.en: Do you know what I'm amazed by?
lines.zh: 你知道讓我驚嘆的是什麼嗎？

lines.en: Hathaway, how she walks in stilettos on cobble streets, nay runs. absolutely.
lines.zh: Hathaway 竟然能穿著細高跟鞋走在石板路上，不，是用跑的。絕對是。

lines.en: I watched it again last night cuz the kids wanted to finish it last night before they come to the premiere.
lines.zh: 我昨晚又看了一次，因為孩子們想在來首映會之前把它看完。

lines.en: Even they said, "Look how fast she is."
lines.zh: 連他們都說：「你看她跑得好快。」

lines.en: And just how you just like leap around in your stilettos on cobblestone streets. Yeah.
lines.zh: 還有你穿著細高跟鞋在石板路上跳來跳去的樣子。對。

lines.en: Cannot walk on a barefoot though.
lines.zh: 不過我光腳就不會走路了。

lines.en: Literally cannot walk without falling over on bare feet. But stilettos, you rock.
lines.zh: 真的，光腳走路一定會跌倒。但穿細高跟鞋，你超強。

lines.en: Well, she was 22 when she did that. still do that. No kidding.
lines.zh: 嗯，她拍那部的時候才 22 歲。現在還是可以。真的假的。

lines.en: In this one and I thought, "Oh, let's see this happen."
lines.zh: 在這部裡，我想：「喔，來看看這會怎樣。」

lines.en: I see her run through new york.
lines.zh: 我看到她跑過紐約。

lines.en: I don't actually have words to what it was like to be in this location in the vastness of it, to be that young and that green.
lines.zh: 我真的沒辦法形容，在這麼遼闊的地方拍戲，那麼年輕、那麼生嫩是什麼感覺。

lines.en: And I mean, I just remember I was wearing Louis Vuitton and I And the outfit, too.
lines.zh: 我是說，我只記得我穿著 Louis Vuitton，還有那套服裝。

lines.en: Pat Field had put me in these lovely gloves and I was wearing my own uh Prada shoes that I brought because sometimes uh in a film you the budget doesn't quite stretch and so you provide some of your own favorite accessories.
lines.zh: Pat Field 讓我戴上這雙好美的手套，我穿的是我自己帶去的 Prada 鞋，因為有時候拍電影預算不太夠，所以你會提供一些自己最愛的配件。

lines.en: Great shot as well, that big crane shot coming up. Beautiful.
lines.zh: 那個大吊臂鏡頭往上拍，也是很棒的鏡頭。好美。

lines.en: And I do remember we went to this wonderful restaurant, I think it was maybe called Chez Louis and they're famous for their roast chicken.

lines.en: Oh, that's an amazing restaurant.
lines.zh: 喔，那是一家很棒的餐廳。

lines.en: Everybody wants to be us. Oh.

lines.en: That's the Devil Wears Prada, too. Too. Is it? Mhm.

lines.zh: 在整個續集裡，你最喜歡的拍攝地點是哪裡？米蘭。
